input: Submit my photography to a local art competition

gold.taskTitle: Submit Photography to a Local Art Competition
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to submit their photography work to a local art competition.

questions.title: Which specific local competition are you submitting to?
questions.description: Identify the exact competition name and organizer.

questions.title: What is the submission deadline for this competition?
questions.description: Determine the date by which entries must be submitted.

questions.title: Do you already know which photos you want to submit?
questions.description: Clarify whether photo selection is still needed or already decided.

questions.title: Is the submission process online, in-person, or by mail?
questions.description: Understand the delivery method required by the competition.

questions.title: Does the competition require printed or digital file submissions?
questions.description: Determine the required format for the photography entries.

questions.title: Are there entry fees, forms, or registrations to complete first?
questions.description: Identify any administrative prerequisites before submitting work.

questions.title: How many photos are you allowed to submit as entries?
questions.description: Clarify the maximum or required number of pieces per entrant.
